from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess, tempfile
root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-community-directory')
expected = {'operator-submission-packet.md': 'e96a98a22124ba63287c3047da95b0adcc073077d23e52a4d0e368830afbc0b4', 'director-referral-candidate.diff': '1017529e2e4b4268992686b690268b13d3c4d3ca5d7e98195a853833314360d8', 'raw/awesome-sqlite-readme.md': '17cc9de7d7d8e93b4946fe2f5930181460de70e683d2b837012814dd82a68248'}
actual = {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in expected}
result = {'hashes': actual, 'matches_packet_binding': actual == expected, 'scope': 'Offline application check against captured README. Independent readiness, operator authorization and maintainer acceptance are separate.'}
if actual == expected:
    baseline = (root / 'raw/awesome-sqlite-readme.md').read_bytes()
    diff = (root / 'director-referral-candidate.diff').resolve()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as work:
        readme = Path(work) / 'README.md'
        readme.write_bytes(baseline)
        applied = subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', str(diff)], cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True)
        result.update(apply_exit=applied.returncode, apply_stderr=applied.stderr)
        if applied.returncode == 0:
            added = [line[1:] for line in diff.read_bytes().splitlines() if line.startswith(b'+') and not line.startswith(b'+++')]
            revised = readme.read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)
            matching = [i for i, line in enumerate(revised) if len(added) == 1 and line.rstrip(b'\r\n') == added[0]]
            result['one_line_addition'] = len(matching) == 1 and b''.join(line for i, line in enumerate(revised) if i not in matching) == baseline
            if len(matching) == 1:
                headings = [line.decode().strip() for line in revised[:matching[0]] if line.startswith(b'#')]
                result['preceding_heading'] = headings[-1] if headings else None
                result['added_line'] = added[0].decode()
output = root / 'operator-patch-application-check.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(output.read_text())
